test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Get itchy feet

options.text: Learn something by memorising it without a thought to what is being learnt
To start to want to travel or do something different
Join a popular trend or activity

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Get itchy feet"** means to start to feel a strong desire to travel or move from one place to another. (यात्रा करने की या कुछ अलग करने की तीव्र इच्छा होना) • **Example:** After working in the same office for five years, she started to get itchy feet and wanted to travel the world. • **"To start to want to travel or do something different"** refers to the feeling of restlessness and the desire for change or new experiences. (कुछ अलग करने की या यात्रा करने की इच्छा) • **Example:** He had been living in the same town all his life, and now he was getting itchy feet and wanted to explore new places. Therefore, the correct answer is: ***To start to want to travel or do something different.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Judge something primarily on appearance** (दिखावट के आधार पर कुछ आंकना): • **Example:** You should not judge a book by its cover; it's important to understand its content. • **Learn something by memorising it without a thought to what is being learnt** (बिना सोचे समझे कुछ याद करना): • **Example:** Rote learning often leads to students memorising information without truly understanding it. • **Join a popular trend or activity** (लोकप्रिय प्रवृत्ति या गतिविधि में शामिल होना): • **Example:** Many people decided to join the fitness craze and started going to the gym regularly. 2ec:Tc45, The correct answer is **Option 4**.
